senses.gloss: (sub. יַד) f.(b. h.; v. אָמַן) [firm,] right hand.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 37a:2">Men. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>מה כתיבה בִּי׳</he> as the writing is done with the right hand, so is the binding to be done with the right hand (on the left).
<cite ref="Menachot 37a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>אטר … בִּימִינוֹ וכ׳</he> a left-handed man ties the T’fillin on his right hand, because this is his left (weak) hand.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah, Petichta 24">Lam. R. to II, 3</cite> (ref. to <he>קץ הימין</he>, <cite ref="Daniel 12:13">Dan. XII, 13</cite>) <he>קץ נתתי לִימִינִי וכ׳</he> I have fixed a term to (the servitude of) my right hand (power); when I redeem my children, I vindicate my right hand.
<cite ref="Zevachim 62b:8">Zeb. 62ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>דרך י׳</he> towards the right; a. fr.—Denom. <cite ref="J00421"><he>יְמָנִי</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="J00421"><he>יְמָנִית</he></cite>.
